verdict.rationale: Postmark publishes an llms.txt for LLM-friendly API consumption and has an official MCP server (ActiveCampaign/postmark-mcp) that would let an AI agent operate the product via natural-language instructions mapped to API calls, as confirmed in community discussion distinguishing it from an unrelated malicious third-party clone. However, the official server appears to have very low adoption/visibility (1 watch, 0 forks, 2 stars) and there's no first-party documentation pack describing its capabilities in depth. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs/examples for the official MCP server, independent hands-on verification of its reliability, and broader usage evidence beyond a single HN thread.
